# H&Q Design Services - Full Knowledge Documentation

## About the Organization
H&Q Design Services (HANDQ) is a multidisciplinary architecture, interior design, and structural engineering firm headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan. The studio operates dedicated desks in DHA Phase 6 Lahore and Parkview City Lahore, alongside an international consultation desk for Pakistani expatriates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

## Core Specializations
1. Architectural Blueprints & Working Drawings: Comprehensive 2D floor plans, elevation drawings, section details, and LDA/DHA submission drawing sets.
2. Photorealistic 3D Facade & Elevation Rendering: High-definition exterior visualization for 3 Marla, 5 Marla, 10 Marla, 1 Kanal, and commercial buildings in Spanish, Modern Contemporary, Victorian, and Classical styles.
3. Structural & MEP Engineering: Seismic structural design, concrete mix calculations (3,000-4,000 PSI), Grade 60 steel rebar detailing, and plumbing/electrical schematics.
4. Luxury Turnkey Interior Design: Space optimization, custom woodwork, Italian marble selection, false ceiling engineering, and smart home integration.
5. Interactive Construction Estimation: Free online estimation tools for calculating 2026 grey structure and turnkey construction costs across Pakistani cities.
